edits.current: THE PRINCIPAL PAYROLL CASILLA ON THE BASE SIDE. The instruction guide defines it as 'los payments gravables (base sujeta a withholding) efectuados a natural persons por concept de salaries, commissions, prestaciones sociales, travel allowances, representation expenses, fees, emolumentos eclesiasticos, compensation received por el trabajo cooperative associate, payments en especie, payments en acciones y, en general, las compensation for personal services'. NOTE that it is the DEPURATED taxable base, not the gross: for a resident it is the ET art. 388 base after non-constitutive income, art. 387 deductions and the 25% exempt income; for a NON-RESIDENT taxed under art. 408 the base is the GROSS, because art. 408 admits no depuration. Note also that it sweeps in fees paid to natural persons under the art. 383 table, which are not employment income - payroll supplies only the employment component.
edits.proposed: Sum, over every employee paid in the month (all payroll runs of the entity, not one run), of the DEPURATED monthly withholding base of ET art. 388 for residents: gross work income (basic or integral salary plus all other taxable income) LESS mandatory employee contributions to EPS, AFP and the Solidarity/Subsistence fund (non-constitutive income), LESS the total tax relief, where total tax relief = AFC/AVC contributions + voluntary pension contributions + dependants deduction (10% of gross income, max 32 UVT) + prepaid medicine + housing-loan interest + 25% exempt income (max 790 UVT annual / 12), capped at the lower of 40% of (gross income less mandatory contributions) and 1,340 UVT annual / 12. In the client's Base of Withholding this is column U 'WITHOLDING TAX BASIS' (not column W). [DECISION PENDING - see Query to RA] Employees taxed under ET art. 408 as non-residents (client Tax Procedure 3, rate 20%): their base is the GROSS work income (Base of Withholding column G 'Income Total'), not column U; confirm whether they are declared here or in casillas 109/110 via sheet 2. Also sweeps in fees paid to natural persons under the art. 383 table, which payroll does not supply. Rounding: keep per-employee bases in whole pesos; round only the monthly aggregate to the nearest 1,000.
edits.reason: Evidence-backed clarification of the depuration actually computed (AFC/APV and the 40% / 1,340 UVT cap are missing from the current text), of the source column (U, not W) and of monthly aggregation across runs. The non-resident routing sentence is flagged DECISION PENDING, not decided.
edits.evidence: Base of Withholding: U = G - H - S on 256/261 employees; S = min(I+J+L+M+N+P, R = 40% x (G-H), 5,848,430) on 261/261; V = U x D on 96/103 Procedure-2 employees.

edits.current: THE PRINCIPAL PAYROLL CASILLA ON THE WITHHOLDING SIDE. The month's total withholding at source on work income paid to natural persons. Must reconcile to the sum of RetencionFuente (NIE177) across every electronic payroll document for the same month, after the nearest-1,000 rounding. It is one of the forty-two casillas summed into casilla 130.
edits.proposed: THE PRINCIPAL PAYROLL CASILLA ON THE WITHHOLDING SIDE. Sum of the income-tax withholding at source actually practised on work income paid to natural persons in the calendar month, across EVERY payroll run of the entity in that month (regular, off-cycle and termination runs), in whole pesos, then rounded once to the nearest 1,000. Sources in the client's payroll: WT 2552 'Income Tax (employee)' (Deductions), plus, for tax-equalised employees where 2552 is booked as a net-zero non-cash item, WT 21330 'Personal Income Tax Withholding (Theoretical)' - together they reconcile to the Base of Withholding column V 'WITHOLDING TAX WITH CONTRIBUTION'. Do NOT use column X 'WITHOLDING TAX WITHOUT CONTRIBUTION'. [DECISION PENDING - see Query to RA] (a) whether CONTINGENT WITHHOLDING (column Y, = X - V, arising from AFC/voluntary-pension contributions) is excluded from this casilla; (b) whether withholding booked on WT 21129 (terminations), 25832 (stock-award vesting), 25833 and 25834 (IC local / hypothetical foreign) enters here in the month it is practised; (c) whether withholding on employees taxed under ET art. 408 (Tax Procedure 3) is reported here or in casillas 111/112. Must reconcile to the sum of RetencionFuente (NIE177) across every electronic payroll document of the same month. One of the casillas summed into casilla 130.
edits.reason: Developer needs the WT sources, the column to use (V), the all-runs-of-the-month rule and the open treatment of contingent/theoretical/other withholding WTs.
edits.evidence: G2N 2552 = V for 255/261 employees; 2552 + 21330 = GRAND TOTAL V (1,468,500,598) exactly; Y = X - V on 20/20; Accumulated 2552 Sep has 144,635,503 for 97 IDs outside the run; other withholding WTs 21129, 25832, 25833, 25834 in other months.

edits.proposed: The client pays WT 62151 'Retirement Payment - PRV-6795' directly to 13 retirees (Sep-2026; 6.7M-14.6M COP, all below 1,000 UVT) and withholds income tax on WT 21140 by applying the ET art. 383 table to 75% of the payment (e.g. 6,716,577 -> 11,762). Under the rule in this row only the excess over 1,000 UVT is taxable. Are these payments pensions under ET art. 206 num. 5 (casillas 78/94, and then no withholding would arise below 1,000 UVT) or work income (casillas 77/93)? The retirees sit outside the regular payroll run, so the Form 350 must aggregate their pay group either way.
edits.reason: Client practice contradicts the spec rule; requires RA answer with official source.
